environment.description: Terraform provider backend deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. Traffic arrives through an internal ALB (scheme: internal) with a listener on port 443. The ALB's security group references a prefix list (pl-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) that resolves to the corporate VPN egress NAT pool (10.200.0.0/16) and the CI/CD runner subnet (172.30.44.0/23). The VPC has no internet gateway attached to the private subnet, and the only route to the ALB is through a Transit Gateway peering from the corporate network. DNS for the service endpoint (tfbackend.internal.corp) is served by a Route53 private hosted zone associated only with the corporate VPC. External resolution is not possible. The prefix list is managed by a separate NetworkOps team via a Service Control Policy that denies ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList to all principals except the NetworkOps automation role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/netops-prefixlist-mgmt).

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, private subnet, no IGW
config.routing: Transit Gateway peering from corporate network only
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, not externally resolvable
config.database: PostgreSQL RDS in same private subnet
